title: Causal-TGAN
summary: Causal-TGAN is a research implementation of a causally-aware tabular-data GAN that conditions generation on a user-supplied causal graph, with an accompanying cybersecurity implementation guide comparing it to other tabular synthesizers. Its dataset preprocessing pipeline imports RDT's OneHotEncoder (carried over from the original sdv-dev CTGAN codebase), and its documentation describes running SDV's CopulaGAN as a baseline comparison.
evidence: dataset.py:8 'from rdt.transformers import OneHotEncoder' with comment '# from https://github.com/sdv-dev'; docs guide shows 'from sdv.tabular import CopulaGAN'
